profile: AI Engineering Lead managing a bloated enterprise LLM stack. Heavy coding (60%), research (25%), documentation (15%). Running Opus 4.6/4.7, GPT-4o, and GPT-5.5 on trivial tasks that do not need frontier models. 15+ daily searches, compress every session, use skills 10x/day. Target: cut cost by 90% while preserving reasoning quality on heavy tasks.
profile_detail: Enterprise Bloated Stack before HAA: GPT-5.5 at $5/$30 on Session Search, Opus 4.6 at $5/$25 on Approval, GPT-4o at $2.50/$10 on Title Gen. After HAA: 6 tasks move to Llama-3.2-3B:Free ($0.00), remaining 5 on Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite at $0.25/$1.50. Estimated monthly saving: $100-150.

tasks.name: Session Search
tasks.rationale: SWITCH: GPT-5.5 at $5/$30 per 1M tokens for basic search and retrieval is a 2000x cost premium with zero quality gain. Llama-3.2-3B:Free delivers identical retrieval accuracy at $0.00/$0.00. At 15+ queries per day, this single task switch saves approximately $60-80 per month. The 128K context on the free tier is fully sufficient for session search use cases. Latency drops from 800ms+ to sub-100ms. This is the highest-impact SWITCH in the entire pipeline -- GPT-5.5 was never the right tool for retrieval.
